children: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 16, 2026) - Rokmaster Resources Corp.
(OTCQB: RKMSF) (FSE: 1RR1) ("Rokmaster" or "the Company") is pleased to provide an update for its 100% owned Selkirk Project ("Selkirk").
Selkirk is comprised of two mineral properties located north of Revelstoke in southeastern British Columbia
Selkirk has been steadily advanced by Rokmaster since 2021 with positive results generated from geological mapping, prospecting, channel sampling, and soil sampling.
A small work program completed on the Downie Gold Property ("Downie") in 2026 returned high-grade tungsten over good intervals near the northern extent of the FIM Skarn Horizon

The FIM Skarn Horizon is a 20-30 meter thick skarn-altered (diopside-pyrrhotite-garnet) horizon developed in calcareous phyllite near the northeastern intrusive contact to the Cretaceous Long Creek Stock. Meter-scale exposures of massive garnet-diopside skarn mineralization are concentrated near the base of the horizon which strikes to the northwest and dips at ~40° to the northeast. Field work completed at Downie in 2025 confirmed tungsten mineralization near the southern end of the previously mapped FIM Skarn Horizon which has a strike length of approximately 2.0 km1. For comparison of the tungsten grades, Almonty Industries Inc. flagship Sangdong Mine in South Korea, historically one of the world's largest and highest-grade tungsten deposits, holds a Probable Mineral Reserve of 8.579 Mt at 0.42% WO3 using a cut-off of 0.15% WO3.2

The Company applied for an additional 422 hectares of mineral claims covering the northern contact of the Long Creek Stock. Downie also hosts Ag-Au-Pb-Zn skarn, vein, and replacement mineralization in the Melt and KJ Zones where a Multi-year Area Based ("MYAB") exploration permit is currently approved.

"The FIM Skarn Horizon is extensive with a significant 2.0 kilometer strike length, which remains open, and 20-30 m widths of skarn-related alteration suggesting a large mineralized system. The high-grade tungsten collected from near the base of the FIM Skarn Horizon returned widths and grades of tungsten comparable to other significant systems, some of which are now in production as
tungsten has seen rapidly rising demand for supply-chain security and defense readiness. I've been hunting tungsten in southern BC since 1977 and this is the best potential I've seen."
Footnote 1: Vanderpoll, W. 1982. 1982 FIM Claims Assessment Report. BC Assessment Report Database #11164.
Footnote 2: Wheeler, A. 2025. NI 43-101 Technical Report on the Mineral Resources and Reserves of the Sangdong Project, South Korea. Almonty Industries Website.

Chip Samples were collected using multiple hammers over measured intervals as perpendicular as possible to the strike and dip of the mineralized horizons and can be considered representative over their reported length, true thickness cannot be determined at this time. Samples were delivered to MSA Laboratories for a preparation of crushing 1kg to 2mm, split 250g & pulverize to 85% to -75µm then subject to a 30 g Fire Assay with AAS finish. All samples were subject to 4-acid and ICP-MS finish for 48 elements and those that returned >1,000 ppm W were sent for borate fusion with a XRF finish to determine tungsten trioxide concentration.

The technical information in this news release has been prepared in accordance with Canadian regulatory requirements as set out in National Instrument 43-101 and reviewed and approved by Linda Caron, P.Eng., who is independent of Rokmaster.
